analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($404.40) vs SMA5 ($469.74)/SMA20 ($535.25)/SMA50 ($547.37): Below, indicating short-to-mid-term bearish trend position.
· Below SMA100 ($527.50)/SMA200 ($415.00), confirming mid-to-long-term bearish trend strength.

· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.4599 → -13.6001): Continued worsening, diagnosing strengthening bearish trend.

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($469.22): First resistance level on any short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High confirmed): Confirming continuation of the downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.00x): Increased volume accompanying the sharp decline, raising confidence in the downside move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Potential for further decline due to RSI entering oversold and MACD worsening; maintain a wait-and-see approach.
